column1: Bobby Witt Jr. leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a reliable track record, reaching safely in nearly three-quarters of his games while enjoying a favorable platoon edge against Payton Tolle. Jake McCarthy offers similar reliability with a slight edge in recent form and also draws a soft matchup. Luis Arraez remains a steady option, consistently producing hits and benefiting from a favorable park and pitcher. All three present dependable choices for Beat The Streak lineups tonight.
